en.bilal-muhammad: Ajmad b. Muhammad b. Ishaq al-Dinuri narrated to us. He said: Abu `Abd al-Rahman Ahmad b. Shu`ayb b. `Ali al-Nasa’i narrated to us in Egypt. He said: Muhammad b. Wahb informed me. He said: Miskin b. Bukayr narrated to us. He said: Shu`ba narrated to us from Abi Balaj from `Amr b. Maymun from Ibn `Abbas. He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) ordered for the doors of the Mosque be closed except for the door of `Ali (as).
